{{Quote|The new batch of troops arrived today; the 22nd infantry division, fresh from our hidden training base in the Outer Rim.|Rahm Kota|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
The '''22nd infantry division''' was a [[Infantry/Legends|military]] [[Division/Legends|unit]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that was formed in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Trained at a [[Unidentified Rebel Alliance training base|hidden base]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], they had not seen combat. Despite their fear, they harbored a hatred for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] planned to use against the numerically superior [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="TFU2d" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 22nd infantry division was mentioned in the Rebel Soldiers' Databank entry in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
